name: Swift TV Ltd
summary: Swift TV Ltd, an Australian company established in 1983 and headquartered in West Perth, delivers television content and communication services to out-of-home environments throughout Australia. Its core offerings include Swift Access, an entertainment and engagement platform optimized for low-bandwidth settings, delivering a variety of TV-based content and interactive communications. They also provide Swift Broadcast, which features traditional television channels and electronic program guides. The company designs and deploys extensive network infrastructure, utilizing both passive technologies like coaxial, GPON, and fibre optics, and active systems such as wireless, ethernet, switching, and DOCSIS. This is complemented by comprehensive network services, including firewalls, routing, captive portals, data management, and IPTV solutions. Further capabilities encompass MATV, VSAT and LEO satellite services, CCTV, system integration, and the installation of satellite dishes and antennas. Additionally, Swift TV offers a range of ICT products and services, covering network and Wi-Fi design, infrastructure installation, and entertainment subscriptions. Their broader suite of services extends to consultancy, project management, exploration, in-house research and development, proprietary technology development, collaboration, and continuous client and 24/7 customer support. Swift TV primarily serves the mining and resources, oil and gas sectors, as well as private and government-managed communities within the aged care industry. The company, formerly known as Swift Networks Group Limited, will officially adopt the name Swift TV Ltd in December 2025.
